text: Handling deadlines successfully requires good planning and self-awareness. First, time management is key: break large tasks into smaller steps and set mini-deadlines for each one. Prioritization helps you focus on the most important work first, so you don't waste energy on low-value tasks. Scope management is also essential; be realistic about what you can finish, and avoid adding extra features that were not agreed. Finally, communication matters. If a problem appears, tell your team or manager early instead of waiting until the deadline. Clear updates build trust and allow others to help. With these habits, deadlines become less stressful and more manageable.
